events.title: Beethoven Dies in Vienna
events.description: Ludwig van Beethoven died in Vienna at age 56 after a long illness. He had been almost completely deaf for years, yet he kept composing some of the most admired music ever written, including his Ninth Symphony.
events.significance: His death marked the end of an era in classical music. His work bridged the Classical and Romantic periods and still shapes Western music.

events.title: Bangladesh Declares Independence
events.description: Early in the Pakistani military crackdown on East Pakistan, Bangladesh's independence was proclaimed. The declaration set off the Bangladesh Liberation War.
events.significance: The war ended in December 1971 with the creation of Bangladesh. March 26 is still celebrated there as Independence Day.

events.title: Israel and Egypt Sign a Peace Treaty
events.description: On the White House lawn, Egypt's President Anwar Sadat and Israel's Prime Minister Menachem Begin signed a peace treaty, with U.S. President Jimmy Carter looking on. It ended three decades of war between the two countries.
events.significance: Egypt became the first Arab state to formally recognize Israel. The treaty remains a cornerstone of Middle East diplomacy.

events.title: Schengen Agreement Takes Effect
events.description: The Schengen Agreement came into force and removed routine border checks between participating European countries. Travelers could cross between them without showing a passport.
events.significance: The Schengen Area grew to cover most of Europe. It is one of the most visible results of European integration.
